svg.title: Vertical · 41.90° N, 12.50° E
svg.desc: Vertical · 41.90° N, 12.50° E. Zone time UTC+01:00; subtract the equation of time from the dial reading. Europe/Rome; design date 2026-01-15. Radius 180 mm. Mount vertically, wall declining 25° from south, top of the design upward. The style projects out from the wall at 42.4°. Its base runs 154.8° clockwise from the upward plumb line as viewed from the front. Nodus 57.6 mm along the style from its foot.
